$description: Two typefaces with distinct roles (Figma 'Foundations' > Typography). Fraunces is Scout's personality; Avenir Next is Scout's clarity.

display.$description: Wordmark, editorial headlines, introductions, discovery moments, brand storytelling.

ui.$description: Navigation, body, buttons, forms, labels, metadata, product UI.

display-variation.$description: Fraunces axis settings used throughout the Figma file.

size.$description: 12-28 from the Foundations frame (15 is intentional, not rounded); 24 from Color + Text; 36 and 96 are the existing page-title and sign-in wordmark sizes.

tight.$description: Figma tracking -1%, used on Fraunces and UI text in Color + Text.
